items.source_en:
As many of you are aware, a press release is being issued today to announce that BioTech Industries has officially acquired SyntheTech Industries. 

The SyntheTech Industries brand will remain intact and will continue to be headquartered at their current location in Imperial Center. To further aid in the transition, we've also opened a satellite office here in BioTech Tower. 

Infinity has been a long standing competitor with BioTech, so adding them to our arsenal will only increase our presence and position in the tech industry.

Ularu Chen
CEO, BioTech Industries
